metadata.description: Meta-marketplace aggregating Bastien Gallay's Class-A Claude skills. Each plugin is sourced from its own independently-versioned repository.

plugins.name: bfw
plugins.description: Facilitated brainstorming skill with adaptive technique sequencing.

plugins.name: contre-expertise
plugins.description: Critical, sourced counter-assessment of a working method.

plugins.name: feature-torture
plugins.description: Pressure-test one roadmap feature per session and emit a decision report.

plugins.name: market-strategist
plugins.description: Strategic advisor for market analysis, positioning, traction, pitch and project communication.

plugins.name: pair-with-me
plugins.description: Work one issue as an adversarial pair, not a delegation.

plugins.name: redaction
plugins.description: Boucle d'édition critique pour écrits longs (articles, billets, essais).

plugins.name: rhetorical-analysis
plugins.description: Analyse rhétorique et épistémologique d'articles, discours et textes argumentatifs.

plugins.name: meeting-screenshot-extractor
plugins.description: Builds a CLI to extract relevant screenshots from a meeting video using a transcript and topics.

plugins.name: show
plugins.description: Visual grammar: which visual the content calls for, and how it renders on each target.
